'''ZelFlight''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engineering firm that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
ZelFlight was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Greddin Zel]]. It had a contract with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which was secured by [[Zerex]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
